decisions.title: Services Lifecycle Management & Customer Group RBAC
decisions.context: Need enterprise-grade lifecycle for services (DRAFT->TESTING->PUBLISHED->ARCHIVED) and customer group access control
decisions.decision: Implemented ServiceDraft, CustomerGroup, ServiceCustomerAccess, ServiceLinkCheck, ServiceEditHistory with strict transactions and SSRF-guarded link verifier
decisions.rationale: Prevents corrupt services on storefront, protects pricing integrity, enables VIP/B2B tier isolation

decisions.title: E2E Test Suite Standardization (Blocks 1-6)
decisions.context: Standardizing E2E tests for core user journeys and admin panels
decisions.decision: Implemented unified Playwright/Vitest E2E suite covering Blocks 1-6 with zero flaky tests
decisions.rationale: Guarantees regression immunity on critical user flows

decisions.title: External Audit Fixes & 11 E2E Blocks 100% Green
decisions.context: Audit findings and 5 new E2E test suites
decisions.decision: Fixed C-1 mass checkout balance deduction, C-2/C-3 float precision BigInt, C-02 IDOR tenant scoping, H-4 quarantine release throw, and integrated Blocks 7-11 E2E tests passing 75/75
decisions.rationale: Fintech level data integrity, multi-tenant isolation, and zero-defect QA guarantees

decisions.title: Financial & Security Invariants Hardening (Zero-Escape & Ledger-First)
decisions.context: Audit remediation and wallet-ops transactional hardening
decisions.decision: Enforced tx-only boundaries, ledger-first balance mutations, fail-closed webhooks, and secure tenant fallback
decisions.rationale: Eliminates race conditions, cross-tenant leaks, and webhook forgery

decisions.title: AI Ecosystem & Monitoring Architecture (Support, Finance, Alerts)
decisions.context: Consolidation of AI services: GeminiClient multi-proxy failover, AiSupportService defense-in-depth RAG, StormDetectorService, LedgerReconciliationService, and SecurityAlertService
decisions.decision: Documented unified architecture: 5-layer AI support copilot, deterministic ledger reconciliation, 24h rolling storm detector, and real-time security alerting with telegram dispatch
decisions.rationale: Ensures single source of truth for all autonomous agents regarding AI, financial audits, operational health, and monitoring capabilities in SMMplan/SMMflux

decisions.title: Официальная спецификация YooKassa API v3 (Active Pull & Webhooks)
decisions.context: Задержки ночных вебхуков и верификация платежей без ожидания
decisions.decision: Использовать GET /v3/payments/{id} с Basic Auth (shopId:secretKey), Redis-кэшем 5 сек и глобальным Rate Limit (max 30 req/min). Вебхук проверяется через HMAC-SHA256.
decisions.rationale: Подтверждено официальной документацией ЮKassa API v3. Исключает блокировку по 429 и решает проблему задержки вебхуков при ночном банковском клиринге.

decisions.title: Официальная спецификация Robokassa Partner REST API 2026
decisions.context: Проверка статусов заказов и отказ от устаревших XML-протоколов
decisions.decision: Для проверки статуса использовать POST /PartnerRegisterService/api/Operation/GetOperations с HTTP Basic Auth партнера (roboxPartnerId UUID + login/password), а не устаревший XML OpStateExt с паролями магазина. ResultURL вебхук проверяет SignatureValue по алгоритму MD5/SHA256.
decisions.rationale: SOAP/XML OpStateExt официально признан устаревшим (deprecated). Актуальная спецификация требует Partner REST API с UUID идентификатором партнера.

decisions.title: Иерархия проверки источников и защита от галлюцинаций (Zero-Hallucination 3-Tier Hierarchy)
decisions.context: Исключение домыслов и устаревшей информации в коде и архитектурных решениях
decisions.decision: При работе с любыми техническими, финансовыми, правовыми или API-системами агент обязан строго следовать правилу 3 ступеней: Уровень 1 — Официальная документация; Уровень 2 — Поиск в интернете; Уровень 3 — Память агента с обязательной пометкой гипотезы и верификацией.
decisions.rationale: Предотвращает внедрение устаревших протоколов (как SOAP в 2026 г.) и защищает бизнес от сбоев.

decisions.title: Social Link Formats & Modern Pitfalls (TikTok Photo Mode, IG Highlights, TG Albums)
decisions.context: 2026 Social networks URL parsing nuances and multi-device sync
decisions.decision: Added TikTok /photo/ recognition, Instagram stories/highlights rules, and Telegram dual-order sync guide
decisions.rationale: Prevents client order failures on new media formats and desync across mobile/desktop

decisions.title: Dzen Link Formats Fix (Shorts, Media, Legacy Yandex Domains)
decisions.context: Resolving edge cases in Yandex.Dzen / Dzen.ru URL parsing
decisions.decision: Added Dzen shorts, media slugs, and zen.yandex.ru legacy domain support to IntelligenceLinkAnalyzer
decisions.rationale: Prevents misclassifying shorts/media as channel and supports legacy domains

decisions.title: Federated Swarm Council 4.0 and Pre-Mortem Security
decisions.context: Optimization audit with multi-agent consensus and security pre-mortem gates
decisions.decision: Orchestrated 5 specialized free models on OpenRouter with Gemini-3-flash failover and strict pre-mortem defense
decisions.rationale: Zero-cost AI swarm analysis with deterministic mathematical guarantees (OWASP, PCI DSS, 54-FZ)

decisions.title: OmniSMM Admin Settings Smart Hybrid Ergonomics Redesign
decisions.context: Admin felt visual overload and disorientation from 8 cluttered tabs.
decisions.decision: Implemented Smart Hybrid Navigation: 4-step onboarding readiness bar (0-100%), 3 master clusters, and Ctrl+K search command.
decisions.rationale: Reduces cognitive load, adheres to Miller Law, improves safety with Dialog confirmations.

decisions.title: BGS-2026: Zero-Defect Blue-Green Stage and Visual Approval Pipeline
decisions.context: Prevent accidental broken builds from rolling directly into production without human preview
decisions.decision: Enforce candidate preview build on port 3005, Puppeteer MCP visual inspection with screenshots, human visual approval gate before production container switch, and 5-second instant rollback image backup
decisions.rationale: Eliminates risk of in-place production container breakages and conforms to enterprise SRE Zero-Downtime standards

decisions.title: Mobile Checkout Payment and Telegram Bot Support Fixes
decisions.context: Mobile wizard checkout ergonomics and telegram notifications stability
decisions.decision: Hardened mobile checkout, typing guard for auto-scroll, safe focus, and telegram CSAT non-blocking dispatch
decisions.rationale: Improves conversion rate and eliminates UI jumps during mobile ordering

decisions.title: SDD-TDD 2026: Spec-Driven & Test-Driven Development Pipeline
decisions.context: Исключение когнитивной предвзятости (Confirmation Bias), галлюцинаций типов и поломки контрактов при генерации кода ИИ-агентами.
decisions.decision: Внедрен строгий 5-фазный пайплайн: 1) Спецификация контрактов и инвариантов в docs/specs/ (Zod DTOs + FSM + Edge Cases Matrix); 2) Human Approval Gate; 3) Написание падающих тестов в Vitest (Red Phase); 4) Минимальная реализация кода (Green Phase); 5) Актуализация living docs. Градация рисков: Tier 1 (Critical) — 100% SDD+TDD; Tier 2 (Standard) — Light-SDD; Tier 3 (Cosmetic) — Direct + Visual Audit.
decisions.rationale: Предотвращает написание "тестов задним числом", гарантирует объективную функцию потерь для LLM через падающий assertion, исключает дрейф контрактов между бэкендом и UI.

decisions.title: OmniSMM Architectural Skills Suite: 11 Доменных Инвариантов платформы
decisions.context: Предотвращение архитектурной эрозии, спагетти-кода и транзакционного побега при автономной работе агентов.
decisions.decision: Развернут и закреплен в AGENTS.md нормативный комплект из 11 специализированных архитектурных скиллов в .agents/skills/ (arch-boundary-guard, ddd-aggregate-invariants, adr-architect, concurrency-acid-guard, db-evolution-zero-downtime, event-driven-reliability, resilience-bulkhead-circuit, multi-tenant-isolation-arch, api-contract-evolver, impact-blast-radius, nfr-performance-budget) и мастер-реестр INDEX.md.
decisions.rationale: Каждый скилл дает агенту четкое дерево решений (Decision Tree), список абсолютных табу (Hard Invariants), премортем-моделирование и чеклист верификации перед коммитом.

decisions.title: Maker-Checker Protocol: Двухагентное разделение контекста разработки и ревью
decisions.context: Авторский когнитивный сдвиг (Author Bias): одна модель не замечает собственных архитектурных и логических ошибок.
decisions.decision: Разделение ролей на Maker (агент с доступом к записи, создающий код и тесты по спеке) и Checker (изолированный Read-Only субагент qa_reviewer). Checker проверяет соответствие контрактам, отсутствие any/TODO, утечек секретов и соответствие семантическим токенам без возможности править код.
decisions.rationale: Полная изоляция ревьюера от промежуточных рассуждений создателя гарантирует непредвзятый аудит и блокирует мерж некачественного кода.

decisions.title: Ephemeral Sandbox & Visual Verification Loop (BGS-2026)
decisions.context: Невозможность гарантировать визуальную корректность UI, верстки и z-index исключительно через консольные юнит-тесты.
decisions.decision: Любое изменение собирается в изолированном Stage-контуре (:3005) smmplan_stage без трогания продакшна (:3000). Проводится автоматизированный Headless аудит через Puppeteer под 4 ролями (Гость, B2C User, Support, Owner) с контролем ошибок гидратации, отсутствия горизонтального скролла и снятием скриншотов перед Human Approval.
decisions.rationale: Исключает падение боевого контейнера, гарантирует соответствие W3C WCAG 2.2 AA и NN/g эвристикам, обеспечивает 5-секундный мгновенный откат.

decisions.title: Continuous Architectural Memory & Temporal GraphRAG (4-Tier Memory)
decisions.context: Архитектурная амнезия при длинных сессиях и сменах контекста между независимыми агентами.
decisions.decision: Внедрение 4-уровневой системы памяти: 1) Working Memory (активная задача); 2) Episodic Memory (.planning/episodes/); 3) Semantic Memory (Neo4j граф зависимостей + локальный кэш .planning/memory_cache.json); 4) Procedural Memory (валидаторы и доказательные пакеты .planning/evidence_packs). Учет фактора затухания (Temporal Decay) для устаревших законов и протоколов.
decisions.rationale: Сохраняет преемственность архитектурных решений, связывает функции с таблицами БД и ADR через топологический граф.

decisions.title: LLM Mutation Testing & Adversarial Red Teaming
decisions.context: Ложное чувство надежности от 100% покрытия кода бессмысленными тестами-пустышками без реальных ассертов.
decisions.decision: Применение состязательного агента-мутатора, внедряющего микро-дефекты в код (ExactMath мутации, инверсия условий Drip-Feed Floor, снятие tenantId скоупинга). Тестовый сьют обязан обнаружить мутацию и упасть (Mutation Score >= 85%). Выжившие мутанты отправляются Maker-агенту на доработку тестов.
decisions.rationale: Тестирует не код, а качество самих тестов. Гарантирует, что тесты отлавливают реальные логические и финансовые сбои.

decisions.title: Multi-Model Jury System: Консилиум разнородных семейств LLM
decisions.context: Семейные слепые пятна отдельных языковых моделей при аудите критических финансовых и инфраструктурных узлов.
decisions.decision: Для Tier 1 Critical задач план и спецификация отправляются вслепую (Blind Review) 3 независимым семействам моделей (напр. Claude 3.7 Sonnet, OpenAI o3-mini/GPT-4o, DeepSeek V3/R1). Для одобрения требуется консенсус >= 2/3 голосов при отсутствии категорических вето (Zero Blocker).
decisions.rationale: Устраняет зависимость от индивидуальных ошибок одной модели, объединяя архитектурную строгость Claude, пентест-экспертизу OpenAI и математическую точность DeepSeek.

decisions.title: Policy-as-Code & AST-Grep Syntactic Guardrails
decisions.context: Текстовые правила в системных промптах нарушаются агентами при переполнении контекстного окна.
decisions.decision: Преобразование ключевых архитектурных инвариантов в машинные AST-линтеры (ast-grep / custom ESLint): блокировка вызова db.* внутри prisma.$transaction (Transaction Escape), запрет "use server" в page.tsx, запрет float-чисел в расчете баланса. Нарушение вызывает мгновенный Build Fail на этапе tsc/pre-commit.
decisions.rationale: Создает непреодолимые компиляционные рельсы, физически блокирующие агенту генерацию некорректных конструкций.

decisions.title: Closed-Loop Autonomous Self-Healing & Telemetry OODA Loop
decisions.context: Длительный MTTR (4-24 часа) при ручном разборе продакшн-ошибок разработчиком.
decisions.decision: Замкнутый цикл реакции на продакшн-инциденты: 1) Observe: перехват необработанного исключения из логов/Sentry; 2) Orient: обезличивание PII и автогенерация воспроизводящего падающего юнит-теста; 3) Decide: поиск коммита-виновника и формулирование минимального хотфикса; 4) Act: верификация фикса на тесте, проверка на Stage (:3005) и формирование 1-кнопочного отчета для человека.
decisions.rationale: Сокращает время устранения сбоев с часов до минут при сохранении полного контроля человека через Human Approval Gate.

decisions.title: SmmplanOrderWizard Monolith Decomposition
decisions.context: SmmplanOrderWizard was 1739 lines monolithic component violating component size limits and maintainability standards
decisions.decision: Decomposed SmmplanOrderWizard into 161-line orchestrator and 11 focused submodules in src/components/orders/wizard/ each <= 200 lines, with useSmmplanOrderWizard hook, strict types, helpers, and preserved hardening contract tokens
decisions.rationale: Full compliance with omnismm-checkout-integrity-guard, flash-component-decomposer and swarm-100-percent-hardening tests

decisions.title: Wave 9 CDD-TDD Support Chat Decomposition
decisions.context: ChatInput.tsx (880 lines, CRAP 32,220) and ChatMessageList.tsx (894 lines, CRAP 22,350) were monolithic hotspots in customer support
decisions.decision: Decomposed ChatInput into 6 submodules and ChatMessageList into 5 submodules. Preserved viewport overflow invariants and full backwards compatibility.

decisions.title: Wave 10 CDD-TDD Checkout Engine useOrderEngine Decomposition

decisions.decision: Decomposed useOrderEngine into 3 dedicated sub-hooks: useOrderDripState, useOrderCatalogSync, and useOrderUrlAnalyzer. Preserved 100% backward compatibility of OrderEngine type contract.
decisions.rationale: CRAP score reduced by 94.7% from 25,122 to 1,332. Total CRAP load fell to 1,510,270. 0 layer violations across 1267 modules.

decisions.title: Wave 11 CDD-TDD Admin Settings Decomposition
decisions.context: general-settings.tsx (1,001 lines, CC 158, CRAP 25,122) and settings-update.action.ts (414 lines, CC 155, CRAP 24,180) were monolithic hotspots in Admin Settings.
decisions.decision: Decomposed general-settings.tsx into 4 focused submodules in src/app/admin/settings/components/general/ and settings-update.action.ts into 4 helpers in src/actions/admin/settings/helpers/. Preserved 100% backwards compatibility and form data contracts.
decisions.rationale: Total CRAP load reduced by 53,306 points (down to 1,456,964). Both files eliminated from project top-5 worst modules. 0 layer violations across 1,278 modules. 100% tests pass.

decisions.title: Wave 12 CDD-TDD Team Management Decomposition
decisions.context: team-management.tsx (1,223 lines, CC 143, CRAP 20,592) was the #4 worst technical debt hotspot in the project.
decisions.decision: Decomposed team-management.tsx into 7 focused submodules in src/app/admin/settings/team/ (4 modals, 3 sections, ui-helpers). Preserved hoisted dialogs, RBAC matrix, and 100% server action contracts.
decisions.rationale: Total CRAP load reduced by 15,324 points (down to 1,441,640). File eliminated from top-5 worst modules. 0 layer violations across 1,288 modules. 100% tests pass.

decisions.title: ADR-2026-20: Interactive Admin AI Manual & Copilot Widget
decisions.context: Interactive guide and operational consultant for admin panel grounded in real code
decisions.decision: Implemented ADR-2026-20 and SPEC-2026-09-19 using Gemini 3.8 Flash, Docker vector memory Qdrant on 6333/8100, rotating API keys and context-aware widget
decisions.rationale: Grounded RAG prevents hallucinations, key rotation and proxy ensures uptime, contextual runbooks streamline operations

decisions.title: Dynamic Domain Resolver and BullMQ Tenant Hotfix
decisions.context: Multi-tenant routing and order processing
decisions.decision: DomainRegistryService and BullMQ tenant context
decisions.rationale: Prevent order hangs and allow dynamic domains

decisions.title: Phase 4: Multi-Tenant Telegram Bot Dispatcher and Webhook Router
decisions.context: Support branded Telegram bots for arbitrary white-label storefronts without brand bleeding, hardcoded tokens, or schema migrations.
decisions.decision: Implemented on-demand Telegraf resolution and webhook dispatching via MultiBotManager, timing-safe HMAC verification in shared webhook handler, and dynamic route /api/webhooks/telegram/[tenantId].
decisions.rationale: Zero DDL migrations using existing TelegramBotInstance table; timing-safe secret check eliminates timing attacks; outbound payment notifications dynamically routed per user.tenantId to prevent brand bleeding.

decisions.title: Dynamic Custom Domain Verification & DNS Probe (OmniSMM 1.0)
decisions.context: Runtime verification of custom domains for multi-tenant white-label storefronts without PostgreSQL migrations
decisions.decision: Zero-migration metadata storage in SystemSetting, dual-channel CNAME + TXT DNS probe via node:dns/promises, dynamic L1/L2 activation in DomainRegistryService, and Anti-Takeover guard for system domains
decisions.rationale: Prevents domain hijacking, requires 0 container restarts, and maintains strict CSP/SSL integrity

decisions.title: Multi-Tenant Fiscal & Payment Gateway Partitioning (Zero-Commingling Guard & 54-ФЗ)
decisions.context: Payment gateway credentials and 54-ФЗ fiscal receipts isolation across multi-tenant white-label storefronts under Russian tax law ст. 54.1 НК РФ
decisions.decision: Restricted process.env credentials fallback strictly to smmplan, eliminated binary brand ternaries, implemented parameterized /api/webhooks/<gateway>/[tenantId] routes, and verified per-tenant 20M RUB VAT threshold calculation
decisions.rationale: Prevents tax commingling, brand bleeding, and illegal revenue routing to incorrect merchant accounts while allowing N-tenants to configure their own acquiring credentials dynamically

decisions.title: SSR Storefront Micro-caching and Docker Pool Tuning
decisions.context: High concurrency stress testing revealed 30 RPS bottleneck on SSR / due to unauthenticated visitor SSR re-rendering and conservative memory/pool limits in Docker
decisions.decision: Increased web container memory to 768MB, V8 heap to 512MB, PG connection limit to 15. Implemented Redis micro-caching for processed services, public catalog and storefront guest bundle (getStorefrontGuestBundle).
decisions.rationale: Boosted SSR throughput by 33% (up to 40 RPS), reduced P95 latency by 25% (down to 647ms), increased online capacity to 1,200+ simultaneous visitors, zero memory leaks or failures.

decisions.title: Google Antigravity Standards Integration & Rules Modularization
decisions.context: Antigravity truncated AGENTS.md due to 24 KB per-file hard cap, causing loss of contract rules
decisions.decision: Modularized AGENTS.md into .agents/rules/*.md files <= 15 KB and added AGY-001 through AGY-004 to linter
decisions.rationale: Guarantees zero contract truncation and validates Antigravity slash commands and Generative UI CDN

decisions.title: Transaction Purity, BullMQ JobId Deduplication and MarginGuard HotSwap Hardening
decisions.context: Audit revealed external API calls inside db., static jobId deduplication deadlocks in BullMQ, and unvalidated margin in SmartRecoveryEngine.
decisions.decision: Moved provider API calls outside transactions, added MarginGuard to SmartRecoveryEngine, and standardized timestamped job IDs for BullMQ.
decisions.rationale: Prevents connection pool starvation, guarantees paid order delivery, and protects against financial loss from provider rate discrepancies.

l1_atomic_invariants.rule: All financial calculations (pricing, balances, refunds, margins) MUST be computed in BigInt integer kopecks using ExactMath with Bankers Rounding and a minimum 1 kopeck floor.
l1_atomic_invariants.rationale: Eliminates fractional float drift, cumulative rounding leakages in mass checkouts, and guarantees 100% compliance with 54-FZ fiscalization.

l1_atomic_invariants.rule: Direct deleteMany calls on Category, Service, and Network models are strictly forbidden on production databases (smmplan_lite). Catalog modifications require ADMIN/OWNER permissions and CatalogLockGuard validation.
l1_atomic_invariants.rationale: Protects production catalog and curated services from rogue seeder resets, accidental worker sweeps, and test environment pollution.

l1_atomic_invariants.rule: SSR ingress microcache MUST implement a Single-Flight Coalescing Mutex to eliminate Thundering Herd on cache misses, and MUST NEVER cache 5xx/4xx/redirect responses or leak Set-Cookie headers.
l1_atomic_invariants.rationale: Guarantees 0.1ms cache hits under 1000+ rps spikes, prevents error response poisoning from corrupting cache, and protects user session cookies.

l1_atomic_invariants.rule: Every balance modification MUST write an immutable audit ledger entry inside the transaction BEFORE incrementing/decrementing user balance. Inside prisma.$transaction, calling external db.* is strictly forbidden.
l1_atomic_invariants.rationale: Eliminates race conditions (TOCTOU), transaction escape bugs, and ensures double-entry accounting audit trail.

l1_atomic_invariants.rule: All queries, cache keys, Redis pub/sub channels, and background jobs MUST be scoped by tenantId (smmplan / smmflux). Cross-tenant queries are blocked by Prisma RLS and AST Guardrails.
l1_atomic_invariants.rationale: Prevents cross-tenant data leakage between brands SMMplan and SMMflux, maintaining separate financial ledgers and brand trust.

l2_scenario_recipes.title: Hardened SSR Ingress Microcache with Weak ETag & Next.js 16 Prefetch Support
l2_scenario_recipes.triggerContext: When handling high-concurrency public storefront traffic (/, /services, /faq, /terms) requiring sub-millisecond response times without overloading React 19 SSR.
actionSteps: Compute cache key distinguishing standard navigation from RSC prefetch headers (next-router-prefetch vs :rsc-pref).
Check active inflight map: if key is pending, join waiters queue without invoking SSR.
If key is fresh, intercept res.end to capture body buffer, stripping Set-Cookie.
Verify res.statusCode < 400 before caching to prevent Error Response Poisoning.
On completion, broadcast buffer to all waiters and send RFC 9110 Weak ETag.

l2_scenario_recipes.title: Vitest Database Isolation & ESM Hoisting Protection
l2_scenario_recipes.triggerContext: When writing or running integration tests with Prisma ORM that could accidentally connect to or mutate production database.
actionSteps: Create test/setup-env.ts as first entry in vitest config setupFiles.
Set process.env.DATABASE_URL to smmplan_test before any module imports db.
Add Prisma extension throwing fatal error on deleteMany for production catalog models.
failureModes: ESM import hoisting db before dotenv initializes
